title: Faiju Uddin v. Purvanchal Vidhut Vitrana Nigam Ltd.
coram: Siddhartha Varma and Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Listed after licensee stated the bill was corrected.
headnote: On a writ following a Clause 6.5 bill-correction application, the Division Bench recorded the licensee's statement that the bill had been corrected, directed the consumer to examine it, and listed the matter.
facts: The consumer invoked Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the concerned authority for correction of a bill and then approached the High Court. Counsel for Purvanchal Vidhut Vitrana Nigam Ltd. stated on instructions that the bill had been corrected, and copies of those instructions were placed before the Court and given to the consumer's counsel. The Bench directed that counsel to examine the corrected bill and make submissions, and listed the writ for 2 April 2025.

holding_units.holding: The writ, brought after a Clause 6.5 bill-correction application, was listed for further hearing after the licensee's counsel stated on instructions that the bill had been corrected; the consumer's counsel was directed to examine the corrected bill and make submissions.

not_decided.point: Whether the corrected bill disposes of the Clause 6.5 objection
